CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Void_Row] 
@T_ID	int	

AS 
SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY NORMAL

BEGIN TRY
BEGIN TRANSACTION 

declare @SumPure FLOAT,@BS_Type INT,@i INT,@IM_ID INT,@D_Valid NVARCHAR(50),@TB_ID INT , @Bill_Num INT

SELECT @BS_Type = BsType_ID , @AG_ID = AG_ID , @TB_ID = Table_ID , @Bill_Num = S_Bill_Pr_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID

IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN SELECT @SumPure = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID END
IF @BS_Type = 7 or @BS_Type = 9 BEGIN SELECT @SumPure = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM Pch_Details  WHERE Pch_T_ID  = @T_ID END

--***************************************************

IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN 	
SELECT @isDepended = isDepended FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID

IF @isDepended = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_Remove] @T_ID END

UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID 

--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END


IF (SELECT TB_Auto_Print FROM Sys_Features WHERE T_ID = (SELECT T_ID FROM Sys_Model)) = 1
BEGIN

DECLARE @Desc NVARCHAR(MAX)
SET @Desc = CONCAT(' إلغاء فاتورة رقم ',@Bill_Num, CHAR(13), CHAR(10), ' طاولة : ',(SELECT TOP 1 T_Name  FROM Tables WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID))

INSERT INTO TB_AutoPrint_tmp (T_ID, Notes, Printer_IP)
SELECT 0, @Desc, GP.Printer_IP
FROM GM_Printer_V GP
JOIN IM_Menu IM ON GP.GM_ID = IM.GM_ID
WHERE IM.IM_ID IN (SELECT IM_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID) AND GP.Printer_IP IS NOT NULL;


END

GOTO FINAL_

END


IF @BS_Type = 2 BEGIN 	
UPDATE EXP_Details SET isDepended = 0 where IMEX_T_ID  = @T_ID 
GOTO FINAL_
END


IF @BS_Type IN (3,4)
BEGIN
Update Treasury_Balance_MV  SET isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE AGBalance_T_ID  = @T_ID
GOTO FINAL_
END

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @BS_Type = 7 or @BS_Type = 9
BEGIN
UPDATE Pch_Details SET isDepended = 0 where Pch_T_ID = @T_ID 
--SELECT @i = min(T_id) From Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL

--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM Pch_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--EXEC ReCount_IM_Main_COST @IM_ID
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END
END

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @BS_Type = 8 
BEGIN
UPDATE IMEX_Details SET isDepended = 0 where IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID 
--SELECT @i = min(T_id) From IMEX_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM IMEX_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From IMEX_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END
END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 10 OR @BS_Type = 11
BEGIN
UPDATE Rtn_Contents  SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID 
--IF @BS_Type = 10 BEGIN EXEC Rtn_Contents_UPDATE_DEPENDED @T_ID END
--SELECT @i = min(T_id) From Rtn_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM Rtn_Contents WHERE T_ID = @i
--IF @BS_Type = 10 BEGIN EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY END
--ELSE BEGIN EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY END
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Rtn_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END
END
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 12 --Store_Trans
BEGIN
UPDATE Store_Trans_Details SET isDepended = 0 where B_T_ID = @T_ID 
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Store_Trans_Details WHERE B_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_F = ST_F_ID,@ST_T = ST_To_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM Store_Trans_Details WHERE T_ID = @i

----EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_T,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_F,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY

--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Store_Trans_Details WHERE B_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i 
--END
END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @BS_Type = 13 OR @BS_Type = 18 -- FRM_ITEM
BEGIN

UPDATE FRM_Details SET isDepended = 0 where FRM_T_ID = @T_ID 

--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN

--SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY
--FROM FRM_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END

--2++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

UPDATE FRM_Contents_Details SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID 

--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN

--SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid='',@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM FRM_Contents_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END

END

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @BS_Type = 17
BEGIN
UPDATE InSale_Details SET isDepended = 0 where InSale_T_ID = @T_ID 
--SELECT @i = min(T_id) From InSale_Details WHERE InSale_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM InSale_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From InSale_Details WHERE InSale_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END
END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @BS_Type = 35
BEGIN
UPDATE OutSale_Details SET isDepended = 0 where OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID 
--SELECT @i = min(T_id) From OutSale_Details WHERE OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID
--WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
--BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM OutSale_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From OutSale_Details WHERE OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
--END
END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FINAL_:


exec [Agents_Balance_MV_Cancel]
    @T_ID = @T_ID,
    @User_ID = 1,
    @Reason = 'إلغاء المعاملة'


UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET SB_isOpen = 0 ,isPause = NULL ,
--Pure = @SumPure ,
Order_isDeleverd = 1
,isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE T_ID =@T_ID



IF @TB_ID > 0
BEGIN
IF ( SELECT COUNT(T_ID) FROM Tables_Bills_NotPied_V WHERE Table_ID = @TB_ID ) = 0
BEGIN
UPDATE TABLES SET isbusy = 0 , TB_ORDER_CODE = NULL WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID
END
END


SELECT @SB_T_ID = Receipt_Tran_ID  FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
IF @BS_Type = 3 BEGIN UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET isPied = 0 WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID END

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Agents_Balance_MV_RCT WHERE Receipt_Tran_ID = @T_ID
WHILE @i IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
EXEC [Agents_Balance_MV_RCT_VOID] @i
--Update Agents_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1 WHERE T_ID = @i
--Update Treasury_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE AGBalance_T_ID = @i
SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Agents_Balance_MV_RCT WHERE Receipt_Tran_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i
END
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


--if @T_ID <> 0 and (SELECT BsType_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID) = 3
--BEGIN exec [AG_Balance_Update_Pied] @T_ID END




COMMIT
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
raiserror ('DB ERROR (AG_Balance_Void_Row)',16,1,'خطأ')
ROLLBACK
END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ST_Balance_Update]
@T_ID INT = null,
@Bill_T_ID INT,
@IM_ID	int,
@D_Valid DATE = NULL,
@ST_QTY	numeric(18, 3),
@Qty_Deference numeric(18, 3),
@Tag char = '',
@ST_ID INT,
@Barcode nvarchar(50)

AS
BEGIN TRY
BEGIN TRANSACTION 

--as
--begin

 DECLARE @U_ID INT,@U_Cargo Numeric(18,2),@Tmp int = 0,@Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50),@T_ID_2  INT,@Cost numeric(18, 3)

SET @Valid_ST = @D_Valid
IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST ='' END


--SELECT @ST_ID = ST_ID FROM ST_Balance WHERE T_ID = @T_ID

SELECT @Cost = ISNULL((COST/U_Cargo),0) FROM IM_STORE_View   WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND ST_ID = @ST_ID

IF @Cost IS NULL BEGIN SET @Cost = 0 END

SELECT @U_ID = U_ID , @U_Cargo = U_Cargo  FROM IM_Menu_Units_V   WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND is_Default = 1
SET @Cost = @Cost / @U_Cargo

IF @Tag = '-' BEGIN SET @Qty_Deference = @Qty_Deference * -1 END
IF @Tag <> ' ' BEGIN
EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_ID] 'ST_QTY_Deferences'
 INSERT INTO [dbo].[ST_QTY_Deferences]([T_ID],[Bill_T_ID],[IM_ID],[ST_ID],[Valid_D],[ST_QTY],[Cost],[U_Cargo],Total,barcode)
                               VALUES (@T_ID,@Bill_T_ID,@IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,(@Qty_Deference * @U_Cargo ),@Cost,@U_Cargo,(@Qty_Deference * @U_Cargo * @Cost ) ,@Barcode) 
 END

 EXEC Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @Bill_T_ID


--SELECT @Tmp = COUNT(*) FROM ST_Balance WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND ST_ID=@ST_ID AND D_Valid = @Valid_ST AND T_ID NOT IN(@T_ID)
--IF @Tmp > 0
--BEGIN
--DELETE FROM ST_Balance WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
--UPDATE ST_Balance  SET ST_QTY += (@ST_QTY * @U_Cargo) WHERE 
--IM_ID = @IM_ID AND ST_ID=@ST_ID AND D_Valid = @Valid_ST
--END
--ELSE
--BEGIN
--UPDATE ST_Balance  SET ST_QTY = (@ST_QTY * @U_Cargo) , D_Valid = @Valid_ST  WHERE T_ID = @T_ID 
--END
--UPDATE IM_Menu SET Cost = (@Cost / @U_Cargo)  WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID

--DELETE FROM ST_Balance WHERE ST_QTY = 0

--COMMIT
--END TRY

--BEGIN CATCH
--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
--raiserror('ST_Balance_Update',16,1,'خطأ')
--ROLLBACK
--END CATCH



COMMIT
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX)
       SET @ERR_STR  = '[ST_Balance_Update] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
	   raiserror(@ERR_STR,16,1,'خطأ')
ROLLBACK
END CATCH



--end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ST_QTY_Deferences_Details_Delete] 
@T_ID	int

AS
BEGIN TRY
BEGIN TRANSACTION

DECLARE @Bill_T_ID INT
SELECT @Bill_T_ID = Bill_T_ID FROM ST_QTY_Deferences WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID

DELETE FROM ST_QTY_Deferences WHERE T_ID = @T_ID

EXEC Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @Bill_T_ID

COMMIT
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
 DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
  SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE()
raiserror(@ErrorMessage,16,1,'خطأ')
ROLLBACK
END CATCH
